arxiv-2101-00872.title: New sequences of non-free rational points
arxiv-2101-00872.creator: Ilia Smilga
arxiv-2101-00872.description: Abstract We exhibit some new infinite families of rational values of τ \tau , some of them squares of rationals, for which the group or even the semigroup generated by the matrices ( 1 1 0 1 ) \left(\begin{smallmatrix}1&1\\ 0&1\end{smallmatrix}\right) and ( 1 0 τ 1 ) \left(\begin{smallmatrix}1&0\\ \tau&1\end{smallmatrix}\right) is not free.

arxiv-2111-11617.title: State Estimation of the Stefan PDE: A Tutorial on Design and Applications to Polar Ice and Batteries Journal: Annual Reviews in Control
arxiv-2111-11617.creator: Shumon Koga, Miroslav Krstic
arxiv-2111-11617.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shumon Koga, Miroslav Krstic. The Stefan PDE system is a representative model for thermal phase change phenomena, such as melting and solidification, arising in numerous science and engineering processes. The mathematical description is given by a Partial Differential Equation (PDE) of the temperature distribution defined on a spatial interval with a moving boundary, where the boundary represents the liquid-solid interface and its dynamics are governed by an Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE).

arxiv-2206-14020.title: Rethinking Adversarial Examples for Location Privacy Protection
arxiv-2206-14020.creator: Trung-Nghia Le, Ta Gu, Huy H. Nguyen, Isao Echizen
arxiv-2206-14020.description: Abstract We have investigated a new application of adversarial examples, namely location privacy protection against landmark recognition systems. We introduce mask-guided multimodal projected gradient descent (MM-PGD), in which adversarial examples are trained on different deep models. Image contents are protected by analyzing the properties of regions to identify the ones most suitable for blending in adversarial examples.

arxiv-2207-00330.title: It is Useful to Analyze Correlation Graphs
arxiv-2207-00330.creator: A.N. Gorban, T.A. Tyukina, L.I. Pokidysheva, E.V. Smirnova
arxiv-2207-00330.description: Abstract In 1987, we analyzed the changes in correlation graphs between various features of the organism during stress and adaptation. After 33 years of research of many authors, discoveries and rediscoveries, we can say with complete confidence: It is useful to analyze correlation graphs.

arxiv-2207-08972.title: Implementación de un Compilador Didáctico para un súper-conjunto de PL/0 Thanks: Este artículo fue presentado en el Congreso de Electrónca e Informática 2010 de la Universidad Centroamericana “José Simeón Cañas” , celebrado el 25 y 26 de noviembre de 2010.

arxiv-2207-08972.description: Abstract En este artículo se describen las características de un compilador para un lenguaje súper-conjunto del conocido PL/0 creado por Niklaus Wirth. La característica principal es que implementa las fases de compilación de tal manera que la información que pasa entre cada una se refleja como un archivo XML .

arxiv-2302-04529.title: Timed I/O Automata: It Is Never Too Late to Complete Your Timed Specification Theory
arxiv-2302-04529.creator: Martijn A. Goorden, Kim G. Larsen, Axel Legay, Florian Lorber, Ulrik Nyman, Andrzej Wąsowski
arxiv-2302-04529.description: Abstract A specification theory combines notions of specifications and implementations with a satisfaction relation, a refinement relation and a set of operators supporting stepwise design. We develop a complete specification framework for real-time systems using Timed I/O Automata as the specification formalism, with the semantics expressed in terms of Timed I/O Transition Systems.

arxiv-2307-08515.title: Reciprocity obstruction to strong approximation over p p -adic function fields
arxiv-2307-08515.creator: Haowen Zhang
arxiv-2307-08515.description: Abstract Over function fields of p p -adic curves, we construct stably rational varieties in the form of homogeneous spaces of 𝐒𝐋 n \SL_{n} with semisimple simply connected stabilizers and we show that strong approximation away from a non-empty set of places fails for such varieties.

arxiv-2310-09501.title: DepNeCTI: Dependency-based Nested Compound Type Identification for Sanskrit
arxiv-2310-09501.creator: Jivnesh Sandhan, Yaswanth Narsupalli, Sreevatsa Muppirala, Sriram Krishnan, Pavankumar Satuluri, Amba Kulkarni, Pawan Goyal
arxiv-2310-09501.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jivnesh Sandhan, Yaswanth Narsupalli, Sreevatsa Muppirala, Sriram Krishnan, Pavankumar Satuluri, Amba Kulkarni, Pawan Goyal. Multi-component compounding is a prevalent phenomenon in Sanskrit, and understanding the implicit structure of a compound’s components is crucial for deciphering its meaning. Earlier approaches in Sanskrit have focused on binary compounds and neglected the multi-component compound setting. This work introduces the novel task of nested compound type identification (NeCTI), which aims to identify nested spans of a multi-component compound and decode the implicit semantic relations between them.

arxiv-2406-01129.title: Patching and multiplicities of p p -adic eigenforms
arxiv-2406-01129.creator: Eugen Hellmann, Valentin Hernandez, Benjamin Schraen
arxiv-2406-01129.description: Abstract We prove the existence of non-classical p p -adic automorphic eigenforms associated to a classical system of eigenvalues on definite unitary groups in 3 3 variables. These eigenforms are associated to Galois representations which are crystalline but very critical at p p .

arxiv-2407-05656.title: Multi-label Learning with Random Circular Vectors
arxiv-2407-05656.creator: Ken Nishida, Kojiro Machi, Kazuma Onishi, Katsuhiko Hayashi, Hidetaka Kamigaito
arxiv-2407-05656.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ken Nishida, Kojiro Machi, Kazuma Onishi, Katsuhiko Hayashi, Hidetaka Kamigaito. The extreme multi-label classification (XMC) task involves learning a classifier that can predict from a large label set the most relevant subset of labels for a data instance. While deep neural networks (DNNs) have demonstrated remarkable success in XMC problems, the task is still challenging because it must deal with a large number of output labels, which make the DNN training computationally expensive.

arxiv-2408-02232.title: SpecRover: Code Intent Extraction via LLMs Thanks: * Joint first authors, ordered alphabetically.
arxiv-2408-02232.creator: Haifeng Ruan *, Yuntong Zhang *, Abhik Roychoudhury
arxiv-2408-02232.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Haifeng Ruan *, Yuntong Zhang *, Abhik Roychoudhury. Autonomous program improvement typically involves automatically producing bug fixes and feature additions. Such program improvement can be accomplished by a combination of large language model (LLM) and program analysis capabilities, in the form of an LLM agent. Since program repair or program improvement typically requires a specification of intended behavior - specification inference can be useful for producing high quality program patches.

arxiv-2511-07368.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Dake Bu, Wei Huang, Andi Han, Atsushi Nitanda, Bo Xue, Qingfu Zhang, Hau-San Wong, Taiji Suzuki. pmc-10691559.title: Abnormally Low Regional Cerebral Oxygen Saturation after Induction of Anesthesia without Neurological Abnormality: A Case Report
pmc-10691559.creator: Jun Honda, Shiori Tanaka, Keisuke Yoshida, Satoki Inoue
pmc-10691559.description: Measurement of regional cerebral oxygen saturation (rSO2) using near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) in cardiac surgery is known to be useful in reducing postoperative neurological complications. We here present a case of a 71-year-old man in whom severe decrease in unilateral rSO2 was observed after induction of general anesthesia for percutaneous mitral valve clipping, although no neurological abnormalities were found.

pmc-10826869.title: Bipolar affective disorder in India: A multi-site population-based cross-sectional study

pmc-10826869.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Introduction:Bipolar Affective Disorder (BPAD) merits careful consideration within the medical and healthcare communities, researchers, and policymakers. This is due to its substantial disability burden, elevated prevalence of co-morbidities, heightened lifetime risk of suicidality, and a significant treatment gap.

pmc-11704573.title: Effectiveness of psychodrama on mental health outcomes based on Chinese samples: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled studies
pmc-11704573.creator: Xiaohui Wang, Rui Ding, Rui Luo, Nino Makhashvili, Judith Bass, Nino Makhashvili, Judith Bass
pmc-11704573.description: BackgroundPsychodrama (PD), supported by extensive global research, is increasingly becoming a vital method for alleviating psychological symptoms and promoting mental well-being in diverse populations across China. However, comprehensive evidence based on rigorous interventions is currently lacking.MethodsThis article systematically reviews the literature on randomized controlled experimental intervention studies of PD in the Chinese Mainland from 1982 to 2023.

pmc-12567892.title: Understanding Patient Experiences: A Mixed-Methods Study on Barriers and Facilitators to TB Care-Seeking in South Africa
